build_system: pnpm workspaces with Vite for bundling
verification_instructions: Run pnpm run typecheck to verify all types pass. The project uses tsc --build for libs and recursive typecheck for artifacts/scripts.
environment_constraints: Network mode needs checking. Build relies on pnpm and TypeScript ~5.9.3.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns. Skills-based workflow described in AGENTS.md but we are doing direct implementation.
key_patterns: React hooks use useRef for stable references, useCallback with dependency arrays. API layer uses serverless handlers with caching Maps. Polling uses a PollingManager class singleton. State mutations use read-then-write pattern.
directory_structure: src/ contains React app (hooks/, components/, services/, utils/, shared/types). api/ contains serverless functions with api/_lib/ for shared server utilities. lib/ for shared libraries.
